T: Jet lagged, wide awake, and hungry.
D: A fading actor and a young woman, both stuck awake in a Tokyo hotel, form an unlikely bond.
P: Serve the mains when Bob and Charlotte sit down to cook their own shabu-shabu.
S: Salted sesame edamame with rice crackers and wasabi peas
Edamame steamed 4 minutes, tossed with flaky salt and sesame oil, and rice crackers with wasabi peas in little lacquer bowls.
Soy and ginger marinated chicken, double fried until crisp, with mayo and lemon
Chicken thigh pieces marinated in soy, sake, ginger and garlic for an hour, coated in potato starch, fried at 160C, rested, fried again at 190C. Japanese mayo and lemon.

Warm seasoned short grain rice pressed into triangles around tuna mayo or flaked salted salmon, wrapped in crisp nori just before eating. Wash 400g short grain rice until clear and cook with 480ml water. Season with salt and cool until just warm. Mix a 185g tin of tuna with 3 tbsp Japanese mayo and a little soy. Salt a 200g salmon fillet, grill 8 minutes and flake. With wet, salted hands shape 8 triangles, pushing a spoon of filling into the middle of each. Wrap with nori strips just before eating.
M: Thin sliced beef, tofu and vegetables swished in kombu broth, dipped in ponzu
Kombu simmered in water for a broth at the table, paper-thin beef, tofu, wombok, enoki and spring onion swished through, dipped in ponzu and sesame sauce. Rice to finish.
Kyoto kitsune udon with soft egg
Charlotte's day trip to the temples

Thick udon in a dashi of kombu and bonito with soy and mirin, topped with sweet simmered tofu, a soft egg, spring onion and tempura flakes. Soak a 10cm piece of kombu in 1.6L water for 30 minutes, bring to a simmer, remove and add 20g bonito flakes. Steep 5 minutes and strain, then season with 4 tbsp soy and 3 tbsp mirin. Simmer 4 fried tofu pouches in 200ml of the broth with 1 tbsp sugar for 10 minutes. Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes. Cook 800g fresh udon for 2 minutes, divide into bowls and top with broth, tofu, halved eggs, spring onion and tempura flakes.
W: Creamy matcha ice cream scooped into waffle cones
Matcha whisked into sweetened condensed milk and cream, whipped to soft peaks, frozen 6 hours, scooped soft into cones.
K: Japanese whisky and cold soda water over ice with a lemon twist
45ml Japanese whisky in a tall glass packed with ice, topped with very cold soda water, stirred once, a twist of lemon.

dishes.make_ahead: Best steamed just before serving; the crackers and wasabi peas can be set out in bowls up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Steam the edamame.
Toss with flaky salt and a little sesame oil.
Serve in small bowls with rice crackers and wasabi peas.
Cut the chicken into pieces and mix with the soy, sake, ginger and crushed garlic.
Marinate in the fridge.
Coat in potato starch and fry in the vegetable oil at 160C, then rest.
Fry again at 190C until crisp.
Serve with mayonnaise and lemon.
Cut the chicken into pieces and mix with the soy, stock, ginger and crushed garlic.
Marinate in the fridge.
Coat in potato starch and fry in the vegetable oil at 160C, then rest.
Fry again at 190C until crisp.
Serve with mayonnaise and lemon.
Press the tofu between paper towels under a heavy board, then tear into bite-sized pieces.
Mix with the soy, sake, ginger and crushed garlic.
Marinate in the fridge.
Coat in potato starch and fry in the oil at 160C, then rest.
Fry again at 190C until crisp.
Serve with mayonnaise and lemon.
Press the tofu between paper towels under a heavy board, then tear into bite-sized pieces.
Mix with the soy, rice vinegar, water, ginger and crushed garlic.
Marinate in the fridge.
Coat in potato starch and fry in the oil at 160C, then rest.
Fry again at 190C until crisp.
Serve with mayonnaise and lemon.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak the kombu in the water up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; slice the vegetables and tofu up to 1 day ahead and keep covered and chilled. Cook the rice and simmer the broth at the table

steps.text: Soak the kombu in the water.
Slice the wombok, enoki and spring onions, slice the tofu and arrange on platters with the beef.
Cook the rice.
Bring the broth to a simmer at the table. Swish the beef, tofu and vegetables through the broth and dip in ponzu.

veg.make_ahead: Soak the kombu and dried shiitake in the water up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; slice everything up to 1 day ahead and keep covered and chilled, and mix the ponzu up to 3 days ahead. Cook the rice and simmer the broth at the table

steps.text: Soak the kombu and dried shiitake in the water.
Slice the firm tofu, tofu puffs, king oyster mushrooms thinly lengthways, wombok, enoki and spring onions and arrange on platters.
Mix the soy, lemon juice and rice vinegar into a ponzu.
Cook the rice.
Bring the broth to a simmer at the table. Swish the tofu, mushrooms and vegetables through the broth and dip in the ponzu.
Whisk the matcha into the condensed milk.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold through.
Freeze.
Scoop soft into waffle cones.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the whisky and soda water up to 1 day ahead; nothing else to do. Build each glass over ice to order

steps.text: Pack four tall glasses with ice.
Add the whisky to each and top with very cold soda water.
Stir once and add a twist of lemon. Sip it slowly, jet-lagged, at the hotel bar.

af.make_ahead: Tea up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the barley tea in the boiling water for 5 minutes, stir in the honey and chill until very cold.
Pack four tall glasses with ice.
Add 120ml of the cold tea to each and top with very cold soda water.
Stir once and add a twist of lemon. Sip it slowly, jet-lagged, at the hotel bar.

s.note: Salted sesame edamame with rice crackers and wasabi peas
s.how: Steam 400g edamame for 4 minutes and toss with flaky salt and a little sesame oil. Serve in small bowls with rice crackers and 100g wasabi peas.

s.note: Soy and ginger marinated chicken, double fried until crisp, with mayo and lemon
s.how: Marinate 700g chicken thigh pieces for an hour in 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp sake, grated ginger and garlic. Coat in 100g potato starch and fry at 160C, rest, then fry again at 190C until crisp. Serve with mayo and lemon.

m.note: Thin sliced beef, tofu and vegetables swished in kombu broth, dipped in ponzu
m.how: Soak a piece of kombu in 2L water for 30 minutes and bring to a simmer at the table. Swish 600g thin sliced beef, 300g tofu, a quarter wombok, 100g enoki and spring onion through the broth. Dip in ponzu. Finish with rice.

w.note: Creamy matcha ice cream scooped into waffle cones
w.how: Whisk 2 tbsp matcha into a 395g tin of condensed milk. Whip 400ml cream to soft peaks and fold through. Freeze 6 hours, then scoop soft into 4 waffle cones.

d.note: Japanese whisky and cold soda water over ice with a lemon twist
d.how: For each drink, pack a tall glass with ice. Add 45ml Japanese whisky and top with very cold soda water. Stir once and add a twist of lemon. Sip it slowly, jet-lagged, at the hotel bar.
